name: How does the firm communicate with clients?

mainEntity.name: How does the firm communicate with clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: We tailor our services to the convenience of our clients. Let us know whether you prefer postal service, text, call, email, or app-based messaging, and we will communicate in whatever fashion is practical for you.
